name: Omigawa Nazuna
source:
Student living in the vicinity
Came to the hospital for disease prevention
-Virgin
-Shy and serious

She had recently received a confession for the first time in her life and was thrilled. Unfortunately, she ended up having that virginity scattered by a ruthless culprit.
